title: A Vampire Bat Starves in Two Nights, So It Begs
subject: vampire bat

scenes.text: A vampire bat that misses two nightly meals in a row will starve.
So what does it do on a night when the hunt fails?
It begs. A roost-mate coughs up some of its blood meal and feeds the hungry bat.
It isn't only family. Scientists recorded who fed whom from 2010 to 2014, in a colony of related and unrelated bats.
Bats that had been generous to non-relatives got fed more when they went hungry.
Vampire bats don't just share blood. They keep track of who shared with them.

description:
A vampire bat that misses two nightly meals in a row will starve.
So hungry bats beg, and roost-mates, even unrelated ones, share blood, especially with bats that shared before.
Would you share your dinner with a stranger?
first_comment: Would you share your last meal with a stranger who once shared with you?
